# Copilot Instructions - Workspace

## Project Focus

- This repository hosts a Dockerized WordPress setup for a BnB website.
- Keep implementation lightweight and suitable for Oracle Always Free resources.
- Prefer maintainable and explicit code over hidden magic.

## Coding Rules

- Use PHP 8.2 compatible syntax.
- Keep WordPress theme templates semantic and minimal.
- Use vanilla JS or jQuery only when needed.
- Keep SCSS and compiled CSS aligned.

## Content Rules

- Primary booking model is full-property rental only.
- Main conversion action is lead capture (request quote / check availability).
- Keep hospitality tone premium but direct.

## Delivery Rules

- When changing theme behavior, update both `functions.php` and related template files.
- When adding front-end interactions, ensure no JS errors without jQuery conflicts.
- Document any operational change in `README.md`.
